text: The patch adds the policy-comparison test path to the rejected-word check's exclusion list. Its Preferences allowance stores literal upstream source-diff lines, including rejected legacy terms. This is a scoped test-data/configuration relationship. The quoted lines are not current production naming or implementation examples, and no lint or policy behavior result was executed.
title: The policy-comparison lint exclusion applies to a file that stores literal source differences
